issue.title: xprompt LSP ignores canonical skill sources, so sase/skills/*.md gets no assistance and never invalidates the catalog
issue.description: In sase-core crates/sase_xprompt_lsp/src/server.rs, markdown_uri_eligible (line 2784) matches only the 'xprompts' | '.xprompts' | 'default_xprompts' path components plus is_memory_note_path, and should_invalidate_for_uri has the same shape; neither knows about the canonical skills root. Verified on sase-core master today: the only 'skills' occurrence in that file is an unrelated generated_skills.md path at line 4275. IMPACT: opening or editing a sase/skills/<name>.md source in an LSP-backed editor yields no completion, hover, or diagnostics, and saving one does not refresh the xprompt catalog, so a newly added or renamed skill stays invisible until the editor restarts. CAUSE: epic sase-hb ('Canonical xprompt skill directories and namespaced invocation') phase sase-hb.1 defined the canonical skills/ layout and its editor contract but never extended either LSP predicate to cover skill roots -- exactly the gap epic sase-hf.1 later had to close for memory roots. That epic was closed 2026-08-11 with this recorded as unresolved residue. SCOPE: add a skills-root predicate to both markdown_uri_eligible and should_invalidate_for_uri mirroring is_memory_note_path, with LSP tests covering a canonical skills source.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-hf.1 — closed phase that added is_memory_note_path to the same two LSP predicates for memory roots; it is the direct template for this fix.
